meta.title: Vendor e-mail when the buyer sends a reminder
gaps: Open the QA vendor mailboxes and verify exactly one reminder email reaches only the non-bidding vendor, with no email to the bidder or any real supplier.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the QA vendor mailboxes and verify exactly one reminder email reaches only the non-bidding vendor, with no email to the bidder or any real supplier.

steps.note: Give the event a searchable title.
Apply the first available template before adding line items.
Add one line item so the event can be published.
Invite two QA vendors so one can bid and the other can be the reminder recipient.
Publish the event before bidding and sending reminders.
Confirm the event reached a real project page.
Have one invited QA vendor submit a bid, leaving the other vendor without a bid.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's Send Reminders drawer for the active event.

args.goal: send the submission reminder to the invited vendor who has not bid, without notifying the vendor who already bid, and stop with the buyer-side send confirmation visible

steps.note: Perform the buyer-side reminder action; the catalog has no dedicated step for pressing the drawer's Notify action.

args.need: open the QA vendor mailboxes and verify exactly one reminder email reaches only the non-bidding vendor, with no email to the bidder or any real supplier

steps.note: Mailbox access and email-recipient verification are outside the Procol browser session.
Retain a final assertion on the buyer-side reminder context after the mailbox check.
